title: The Months: Caesars and Counting
label: ch:months-caesars
canDo: I can name the last six months in French and explain why four of them are counting wrong.

payoff.summary: Two men put their names on a calendar of gods, and the four months after them have been miscounting since long before either was born. juillet is Julius Caesar and août is the emperor Augustus — but neither added a month: Quintilis and Sextilis were renamed. What pushed septembre to décembre two places out was janvier and février, added at the front of a year that used to begin in March.
payoff.note: Authored as part of the chapter-9 split: length is never a cost, so sixteen months-and-seasons became three chapters rather than one dense one. The payoff is atom-scored -- it assesses every atom its chapter introduces.
